create_backend_writer_subclass: create a subclass of BackendWriter that implements _record_step, set_episode_metadata, and close methods
record_step_with_scheduler: record a step using BackendWriter.record_step with StepData and an optional scheduler to filter logging
initialize_backend_writer: initialize a BackendWriter with custom metadata dict and an optional scheduler callable
set_episode_metadata: call set_episode_metadata on a BackendWriter subclass to attach custom data to the current episode
close_backend_writer: close a BackendWriter instance to flush and finalize all logged trajectory data
